t: Integrating Ollama WebSocket Chat with FastHTML for Interactive AI Applications
s: This article explores merging FastHTML's WebSocket capabilities with Ollama's chat API to create an AI-driven web application. The goal is to maintain conversational context and enable real-time, streaming AI interactions within a web interface.
sub: FastHTML and WebSocket for real-time web interfaces
Ollama API for AI chat integration and context retention
Combining web frameworks and LLMs for interactive applications
Simulating long-running tasks and streaming AI responses
